perfil:
Nazuka is a member of the Petal Bloom Guild. She specializes in using large-scale magic to control the battlefield, favoring "brains, not brawn."<ref>Weapon Anecdote: Timeless Grace from Nazuka's stories</ref><ref>CV Excerpt 3 from Nazuka's stories</ref>

She is considered a role model and helped stabilize the local Trekker industry after the withdrawal of the Trekker Association.<ref>CV Excerpt 4 from Nazuka's stories</ref><ref>CV Excerpt 1 from Nazuka's stories</ref> She also authored the Trekker's Handbook and instructed rookies in Philae.<ref>CV Excerpt 5 from Nazuka's stories</ref><ref>Instructor Nazuna from Nazuna's stories</ref>

Nazuka is known for an exhausting work ethic, often laboring from dawn until dusk.<ref>The Determination from Nazuka's stories</ref><ref>CV Excerpt 4 from Nazuka's stories</ref>

builds.d: A DPS build that significantly increases the duration and range of the wind.
A burst DPS build that allows the wind to pull monsters together and penetrate targets.

l.b: While the Main Skill is active, increases Nazuka's Movement SPD and Attack Range. Reduces the Main Skill's Attack Interval.
l.s: While Blooming Draught (Main Skill) is active, increases Nazuka's Movement SPD and Attack Range by ⟦0⟧ and reduces the Attack Interval by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the duration of the Main Skill. If the Skill is interrupted, its cooldown is partially reduced.
l.s: Increases the duration of Blooming Draught (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧. When Blooming Draught is interrupted, its cooldown is partially refunded.

l.b: When the Main Skill is active, Skill DMG increases over time.
l.s: When Blooming Draught (Main Skill) is active, increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ every second. Resets after the Skill ends.

l.b: Increases the Ventus DMG of the Main Skill and increases the targets' Ventus DMG Taken.
l.s: Increases Blooming Draught (Main Skill)'s Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧, and increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 8s, up to 10 stacks.

l.b: While the Main Skill is active, increases Nazuka's DEF. When hit, deals DMG to the attacker.
l.s: While Blooming Draught (Main Skill) is active, increases Nazuka's DEF by ⟦0⟧. When she is hit, deals ⟦1⟧ as Ventus Skill DMG to the attacker. This effect can only be triggered once per second.

l.b: When the pinwheel stops, unleashes a burst of piercing gale, dealing DMG.
l.s: When the pinwheel from Blooming Draught (Main Skill) stops, unleashes a burst of piercing gale, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Ventus Skill DMG. It can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: The Main Skill deals additional DMG and increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken. Also, the wind of the pinwheel can pull in weak targets.
l.s: Blooming Draught (Main Skill) deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as Ventus Skill DMG in 2s, increasing the target's Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 6s, up to 10 stacks. This effect also pulls in weak targets.

l.b: After the Main Skill ends, increases ATK for a short period of time.
l.s: When the pinwheel from Blooming Draught (Main Skill) stops, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 2s.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, increases ATK.
l.s: When casting Blooming Draught (Main Skill), increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: Increases Nazuka's ATK. When there are more than 1 target within the Main Skill's Attack Range, increases Skill DMG.
l.s: Increases Nazuka's ATK by ⟦0⟧. When there are more than 1 target within the Main Skill's Attack Range, increases Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG. The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.
l.s: Increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧.  Aromatic Tempest (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩.

l.b: Nazuka can dodge one more time. Increases her ATK after dodging.
l.s: Nazuka can dodge one more time. After dodging, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: When Auto Attacks deal DMG, there is a chance to increase the target's Ventus DMG Taken.
l.s: When Wind Pellets deal DMG, there is a 30% chance to increase the target's Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: Nazuka can summon more tornados during her Ultimate, and her Ultimate DMG is increased.
l.s: Increases Nazuka's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. Nazuka can summon 4 tornados per Ultimate cast.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG and the tornado's duration.
l.s: When casting Aromatic Tempest (Ultimate), increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 18s. Increases the tornadoes' duration by 66%.

l.b: Increases Nazuka's Ultimate DMG. When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken.
l.s: Increases Nazuka's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. When the tornado summoned by Aromatic Tempest (Ultimate) deals DMG, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 18s, up to 8 stacks.

builds.d: A single-target build that consecutively generates petals that relentlessly track and attack targets.
An AoE build that creates a Flower Formation, synergizing with Ventus DMG.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, continuously creates a dozen Flower Petals at the main Ventus Trekker's location, each dealing DMG and inflicting ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩.
l.s: When casting Bouquet Blast (Support Skill), continuously creates 18 Flower Petals at the main Ventus Trekker's location, with each petal dealing ⟦0⟧ of Nazuka's ATK as Ventus Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩.

l.b: Increases the Ventus DMG of Flower Petals, and they can follow targets.
l.s: Increases the Ventus DMG of Flower Petals by ⟦0⟧, and they can follow targets.

l.b: Increases Flower Petal's Skill DMG. For each Flower Petal created, increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG.
l.s: Increases Flower Petal's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. For each Flower Petal created, increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 8s, up to 12 stacks.

l.b: When Flower Petals deal DMG, increases the targets' Ventus DMG Taken.
l.s: When Flower Petals deal DMG, increases the targets' Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, up to 10 stacks.

l.b: The Flower Petal has a chance to kill a normal target immediately, and its Skill DMG is increased.
l.s: The Flower Petal has a 15% chance to kill a normal target immediately, and its Skill DMG is increased by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the duration of Flower Formation. After casting the skill, when another friendly Ventus unit deals DMG to a target outside Flower Formation, creates another ⟨Flower Formation⟩.
l.s: Increases the duration of Flower Formation by ⟦0⟧. Within 8s after casting the skill, when another friendly Ventus unit deals DMG to a target outside Flower Formation, creates another ⟨Flower Formation⟩. This effect can only be triggered once per second.

l.b: When another friendly Ventus unit deals DMG to targets caught in Flower Formation, Flower Formation deals additional DMG.
l.s: When another friendly Ventus unit deals DMG to targets caught in Flower Formation, Flower Formation deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of Nazuka's ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG. This effect can only be triggered once per second, dealing DMG to the same target no more than once per second.

l.b: Increases the Flower Formation's Ventus DMG. When the Flower Formation dissipates, deals DMG and inflicts ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩.
l.s: Increases the Flower Formation's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧. When the Flower Formation dissipates, deals ⟦1⟧ of Nazuka's ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG and inflicts ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩.

l.b: Increases Flower Formation's Skill DMG. When there are 2 or more targets caught in Flower Formation, increases its DMG.
l.s: Increases Flower Formation's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. When there are 2 or more targets caught in Flower Formation, additionally increases its DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Flower Formation deals DMG, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken.
l.s: When Flower Formation deals DMG, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: Increases all Vanguard and Versatile Ventus Trekkers' Ventus DMG in the squad.
l.s: Increases all Vanguard and Versatile Ventus Trekkers' Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧ in the squad.

l.b: Increases Nazuka's ATK. The Ultimate can inflict ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩.
l.s: Increases Nazuka's ATK by ⟦0⟧.  Aromatic Tempest (Ultimate) can inflict ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩.

l.b: When there is a Flower Formation on the battlefield, increases Nazuka's Skill DMG.
l.s: When there is a Flower Formation on the battlefield, increases Nazuka's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Nazuka can summon more tornados during her Ultimate, and her Ultimate DMG is increased.
l.s: Increases Nazuka's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. Nazuka can summon 4 tornados per Ultimate cast.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG and the tornado's duration.
l.s: When casting Aromatic Tempest (Ultimate), increases Nazuka's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 18s. Increases the tornadoes' duration by 66%.

l.b: Increases Nazuka's Ultimate DMG. When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken.
l.s: Increases Nazuka's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. When the tornado summoned by Aromatic Tempest (Ultimate) deals DMG, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 18s, up to 8 stacks.
